verdict.rationale: Honeybadger is a SaaS error-tracking/monitoring platform, not an AI agent or agent host — the evidence shows Honeybadger exposes its OWN hosted MCP server for external AI assistants to connect to (docs-13, docs-14), which is the reverse relationship. There is no evidence Honeybadger itself acts as an MCP client that plugs in and uses external MCP servers' tools, and this is not a capability this kind of product would be expected to ship.
